answer: Your records do not list any allergies or drug intolerances. That does not prove you have none, because allergies are sometimes never written down. Before any new medicine, tell your doctor and pharmacist about any reaction you have had in the past, including rashes, swelling or breathing trouble, and check your own memory and any old paperwork you have.
